locator.section: Gloria Patri only (s01/w038–057); Holy Ghost becomes Holy Spirit

entries.claim: Historical English wording basis for the Gloria Patri only (s01/w038–057). The received formula uses Holy Spirit for the printed Holy Ghost; the other material wording is retained. This page does not supply the Introit proper, psalm verse or repeated antiphon.

Historical English basis of the antiphon only (s01/w001–024), revised in contemporary language; its reprise (w058–081) repeats that revision. These pages are not asserted as the wording source of the separate psalm verse or the expanded Gloria Patri.
